THE LITTLE CAPTAIN'S GUIDE

How to play

  • ClickLook. Click the ocean, then move the mouse to look around.
  • W A S DWalk. Arrow keys work too.
  • 1Hook. Put the dot on a plank, leaf, or barrel. Click!
  • 2Build. Pick a recipe. Point at a green square. Click!
  • 3Fish. Point at the sea. Click and wait for a bite.
  • TabInventory. Craft and sort your bag. Tab or Esc closes it.
  • LLogbook. Read your bottled messages and achievements.
  • EscPause. Settings, help and quit live here.

Supplies are shared. Nothing can hurt you, and your raft never sinks. Mouse won't lock? Drag the ocean to look instead.

Solo and hosted rafts save automatically. Joining uses the host's world.
